hero.title: Know the Ground.
hero.description: Advanced geotechnical, geophysical and engineering investigation services delivering reliable subsurface intelligence for safer, smarter and more efficient project decisions.

intro.title: Every Structure Begins Below the Surface.
intro.p1: Before a foundation is designed, a road is aligned, a structure is built or an infrastructure project takes shape, the ground needs to be understood.
intro.p2: GEODRILL brings together geotechnical investigation, geophysical surveying, laboratory testing, geological assessment and engineering analysis to transform subsurface information into practical engineering insight.
intro.p3: Our approach helps clients understand site conditions, identify potential ground-related risks and make better-informed project decisions.
